join a call.note: Existing button renders 'Join call' as just 'Unirse'.

leave a call.note: Consistent with channel convention 'abandonar'; only the user leaves, the call continues.

end a call.note: Existing 'End call for everyone' → 'Llamada final para todos' is a mistranslation; should be 'Finalizar la llamada para todos'.

make host.note: Existing menu item: 'Haz de anfitrión'; 'Convertir en anfitrión' is a clearer alternative.

live captions.note: Consistent repo rendering; es-419 would prefer 'subtítulos en vivo'.

raise hand.note: Existing button uses imperative 'Levanta la mano'.

screen share.note: Noun: 'pantalla compartida' ('Detener la pantalla compartida' per existing).

mute.note: Microphone sense; same verb as channel muting.

unmute.note: Webapp convention for unmute; existing Calls strings paraphrase ('Estás sin silenciar').

call ringing.note: Existing settings string uses 'timbre'. Enable call ringing: 'Activar el timbre de llamada'.

pop out.note: Existing 'Pop out' → 'Salir' is a mistranslation (reads as 'exit'); use 'Abrir en ventana separada' or 'Ventana independiente'.

speaker view.note: No repo signal; matches Teams/Zoom es convention.

meeting summary.note: Existing: 'Crear un resumen de la reunión'.
